# Tax management
The tax management module supports indirect taxes such as VAT, GST and sales tax, and helps prepare filings for review; filings are always submitted by your team, never by the assistant.
# Legal and contracts
The legal and contracts module manages contract lifecycles, clause templates, obligations and board resolutions.
# Compliance and obligations
Compliance and obligations tracking keeps deadlines, owners and evidence for regulatory and contractual duties in one place.
